rationale: Full33069file OS/Apps scan finds no LSM303DLHC/DLH/DLM magnetic implementation. Four HMC5883 board address defines are removed as related-protocol names; frozen Zephyr HMC5883L confirms the0x00/01/02configuration,0x03data andH43identity layout, though its gain1090 is not the selected1100XY/980Z scaling. Preserve LSM303AGR and its examples/board integration: its magnetometer has WHO0x4f, CFG0x60..62, STATUS0x67 and little-endian XYZ at0x68..6d; sharing the0x1e address and LSM303 prefix does not make it the DLHC XZY/register-wrap protocol. LIS2MDL and unrelated ST magnetic protocols also remain. Whole-tree identity and process reachability are separate gates.
